ValidationRule.description: PBI14190 - Make the selection of the type mandatory for any Opportunity record associated with the pricebook "ERBE Merchant EKIVITA" (if this pricebook is selected the type must be: "Employee Engagement Platform".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && TEXT(ER_BU_Picklist__c) = 'BENELUX' && $RecordType.Name = 'Merchant Opportunity' && (UPPER(Pricebook2.Name) = 'ERBE MERCHANT EKIVITA' && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Employee Engagement Platform')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRBE05: If PriceBook EKIVITA is selected, the Opportunity type should be Employee Engagement Platform.
